en.title: EIP-7708: the transfer log rules do not cover contract-creation transactions and failed frames
en.summary: The list in EIP-7708 covers a value transaction to a different account and the two creation instructions. It does not name a transaction with an empty recipient field, and the execution specification emits the log for it. The Specification section also does not say what happens to the log when a frame fails; only the Test Cases section lists reverts and rolled-back inner calls among the cases with no log. The execution specification drops the log with the failed frame or an enclosing one, and a creation that fails on an address collision emits no log, because the check comes before the transfer.
en.impact: A contract-creation transaction with value: the list does not cover it, while the execution specification and its test emit the log. A call with value that succeeds inside a frame that later reverts: the Specification section is silent, while the execution specification discards the log. Coding agents wrote correct code from the current text, and all three runs raised these cases. With an earlier draft of the proposed text, one of three still did.
en.correction: Add contract-creation transactions to the list, say that a transfer log belongs to the frame in which the transfer executes and is discarded if that frame or an enclosing frame fails, and say that a transaction that fails before its value transfer emits no log. Proposed in pull request 12613, which also asks the authors whether the log of a contract-creation transaction is meant to be free.
